subtitle: Private editing and publishing
googleShortDescription: Edit, correct, preview and publish videos from your private Studio.
description:
Your videos. Your private Studio.

LazyEdit Studio connects you to an invite-only editing and publishing workspace at edit.lazying.art. An invitation and an internet connection are required. Sign in with your Studio account; each invited member has separate media, settings and platform login profiles. You can link a configured identity provider from Account for later sign-in.

Upload a video, preview it, and prepare it for publication. Add background context to help correct recognition errors while preserving the actual speech. Choose subtitle languages, pronunciation guides, colors, text size, placement, logo and portrait background layout. Review the processed output and metadata before sending a publication task.

Choose supported publication platforms, connect your own social accounts, and follow processing and publication activity. Platform authentication may require a QR scan or verification by the platform. A private, restricted browser view helps with login; publication always uses your selected accounts and platforms.

Native library, upload, settings, activity and account screens are available in English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Vietnamese, Arabic, French, Spanish, German and Russian. The detailed Studio editor remains available inside the app.

Members can delete their Studio account and private workspace from Account after active work finishes. Deleting a workspace does not remove posts already sent to external social platforms. The authorized Vancouver sample lets invited users explore the library without accessing another member's private media.

The current release requires a Studio invitation. It does not offer public unlimited registration or unlimited processing. Monthly subscriptions are being prepared and are not offered in this pilot.

Privacy and support: https://edit.lazying.art/privacy

reviewAccess.notes: Use the separately supplied reviewer account. It opens an isolated member workspace with an authorized Vancouver sample. Upload, editing, processing, metadata review and publication configuration can be inspected. Actual publication requires connecting a social account you control; this is an external platform's authentication requirement. Do not use or request the owner's private Pi or channel credentials. No production owner's private library is shared.
